selection: One SHA-256-ranked row from the first declared collection of each of eighteen members. Public, development-authored material; not blinded case discovery or a representative academic holdout.
grading: Exact typed answer, decision, native unit, and every citation component; narrative rationale reviewed separately by the authoring assistant, not a source-qualified independent specialist. Count each dimension and retain failures.
limitations: Same available assistant family; exact backend build unavailable. No cross-platform inference.
Compact authorized evidence tests use of supplied evidence, not ability to find or adjudicate a publication.
First collection per member is a heterogeneous view, sometimes a register; not an ancient-object sample.
One session per nine-member partition; related tasks share a dossier. Do not treat 54 task responses as 54 independent observations.
No expert acceptance, translation validation or researcher-benefit estimate.
